about: Exploring banter for Phase 5: short exchanges while walking, at most one every three minutes. Never fight barks, and Jev only gestures (COMBAT.md §2.7).

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: I’ve drawn the path we took. It loops twice.

lines.speaker: codex
lines.text: It loops once. The second one was a shortcut.

lines.gesture: Jev looks left, looks right, and hops left

lines.speaker: tollkeeper
lines.text: What has pages but never reads?

lines.speaker: claude
lines.text: A book, usually. Mine are read twice.
